title: Verify dragging the carousel left moves the content without navigating
preconditions: Home page (/) is loaded on the target environment at desktop viewport 1280x800; user is not logged in
Featured Projects section is scrolled into view
Carousel is on the first slide

test_data.drag: mouse down on the first slide image area, move 300px to the left in small steps, release
test_data.note: final snap position is not asserted

steps: Read the translate3d X offset of the slide track and the current page URL
Press the left mouse button on the first slide image area, move the pointer 300px to the left in small steps and release the button
Read the translate3d X offset and the current page URL again
expected_result: The track offset decreases (content moved to the left) compared to the initial value. The page URL is unchanged: the drag does not navigate to a project page.

title: Verify dragging the carousel right moves the content back without navigating
preconditions: Home page (/) is loaded on the target environment at desktop viewport 1280x800; user is not logged in
Featured Projects section is scrolled into view
Carousel is on the first slide
steps: Drag the carousel 300px to the left (mouse down, move, release) and read the translate3d X offset (offset A)
Drag the carousel 300px to the right (mouse down, move, release) and read the translate3d X offset (offset B)
expected_result: Offset B is greater than offset A (content moved back to the right). The page URL is unchanged.

title: Verify a plain click without dragging does not move the carousel
preconditions: Home page (/) is loaded on the target environment at desktop viewport 1280x800; user is not logged in
Featured Projects section is scrolled into view
Carousel is on the first slide
steps: Read the translate3d X offset of the slide track
Click once on the first slide image area without moving the pointer
Wait about 1 second for the slide animation to finish
Read the translate3d X offset again
expected_result: The track offset is unchanged after the click.

title: Verify a very short drag does not break the carousel or navigate
preconditions: Home page (/) is loaded on the target environment at desktop viewport 1280x800; user is not logged in
Featured Projects section is scrolled into view
Carousel is on the first slide
steps: Press the left mouse button on the first slide image area, move the pointer 10px to the left and release
Read the current page URL and check the browser console for uncaught errors
Check that all slides and the Prev/Next buttons are still displayed
expected_result: The page URL is unchanged, no uncaught JavaScript error is raised, and all slides and the Prev/Next buttons remain displayed.

title: Verify dragging far beyond the first and last slide does not break the page
preconditions: Home page (/) is loaded on the target environment at desktop viewport 1280x800; user is not logged in
Featured Projects section is scrolled into view
Carousel is on the first slide

test_data.note: bounds behaviour is not fully characterised; only stability is asserted

steps: Drag the carousel 600px to the right while on the first slide
Drag the carousel 600px to the left three times in a row
Read the current page URL, check the browser console for uncaught errors, and check that the slides, the Prev/Next buttons and the "Featured Projects" heading are still displayed
expected_result: The page URL is unchanged, no uncaught JavaScript error is raised, and the heading, the carousel container, the slides and the Prev/Next buttons are still displayed.
